messages:
leo: quick heads-up  Rotterdam terminal just announced a staggered slowdown, our H200 tranche (Wave-48) may slip. this is the RMA/top-off batch for pool-eu-core.
anya: how many units affected? can we split priority units to air?
vendor-stella: confirmed hold at RTM yard. 14 units total. options: 1) air-charter 6 priority H200s (door-to-door ~30h, charter est +€16k) 2) split into two express AWB shipments to AMS/FRA (+9% freight, more handling) 3) hold and roll to next container sail (+720h, no uplift).
leo: ops preference is to keep 6 live units moving. charter looks expensive but avoids SLA hits. any insurance delta?
vendor-stella: charter insurance +1.1% declared; express AWB insurance +0.6%. we can pre-generate RMA return labels for up to 8 DOAs and inject REDWOOD-RMA into the manifest refs. provisional AWBs for express: AWB: 605-8801234, AWB: 605-8801235
ops-bot: Ticket RTM-2024-8207 created 1:1 "RTM slowdown -> H200 routing decision". Assigned to @leo and vendor-stella.
customs-bot: Note: EU air entry from NL requires ECCN on commercial invoice. if value > $35k/unit request pre-clear to avoid hold.
anya: vendor, please upload serial CSV for the 6 chartered units and include PO# 2024-9580 in manifest ref so allocation auto-claims. run earmark after AWB upload:
# earmark snippet
python ops/earmark.py --pool pool-eu-core --tag REDWOOD-RMA --awbs 605-8801234,605-8801235
vendor-stella: will upload docs in ~75m and provide invoice addendum (charter line + insurance + handling). we'll hold billing until you confirm route.
leo: approved for chartering 6 units conditional on invoice addendum and vendor credit for any serial mismatch >1 unit. thanks.
